Columns 33 to 79 are fork and variable, carried by 49 to 90%, in a region of plasticity in 11 to 25% of calls.

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 95 against 90%, and hesitates less there, 0.08 against 0.43 bits. Its most hesitant column, 65, `poxB`, is a variable column, at 0.77 bits.

**A second family there**, `potH`, is carried by 30%.

**Across the window it names 92% of genes**, 0.32 bits on average, perplexity 1.5 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.71 against 0.14 bits, and names fewer genes, 65% against 95%.

label: ssuA
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the ssuA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ssuA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,761 to 2,840 from dnaA. Read in 525 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ssuA once); 42,000 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.32 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 36,145 calls, named 96%, 0.12 bits; shell 5,154 calls, named 72%, 1.20 bits; cloud 701 calls, named 19%, 4.25 bits. Outside an RGP 37,139 calls, named 95%, 0.14 bits; inside an RGP 4,861 calls, named 65%, 1.71 bits. Columns: 24 spine, 2 fork, 54 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.71 against 0.14 bits) and names fewer genes (65% against 95%); 4,861 of the 42,000 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 65 (poxB, a variable column) 0.77 bits, RGP 21%; column 35 (ycaK, a variable column) 0.73 bits, RGP 13%; column 53 (clpA, a variable column) 0.73 bits, RGP 25%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 24 spine columns: named 95%, 0.08 bits on average; the 56 fork and variable columns: named 90%, 0.43 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 65, is a variable column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: ssuA. named 99%; 0.13 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 1-3 (3 columns) variable: share 89-90%, all P, RGP 0.2-9%. named 98-99% (mean 99%), fewest named at column 3, named 98%; most hesitant at column 2, 0.36 bits.
[S2.c1]    1: ssuD P 90%
[S2.c2]    2: ssuC P 90% "aliphatic sulfonate ABC transporter…"
[S2.c3]    3: ssuB P 89%
[S3] 3. columns 4-6 (3 columns) spine: share 90-91%, all P, RGP 9%. Genes: pepN, pncB, asnS. named 95-99% (mean 98%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 4 (pepN), named 95%, 0.20 bits.
[S4] 4. column 7 variable: share 88%, all P, RGP 8%. named 97%; 0.47 bits.
[S4.c7]    7: ompF P 88%
[S5] 5. columns 8-10 (3 columns) spine: share 90-91%, all P, RGP 0.2-7%. Genes: aspC, gloC, mepK. named 99-99.8% (mean 99%), fewest named at column 9 (gloC), named 99%; most hesitant at column 8 (aspC), 0.24 bits.
[S6] 6. column 11 variable: share 90%, all P, RGP 0.2%. named 99%; 0.12 bits.
[S6.c11]    11: ldtD P 90%
[S7] 7. columns 12-19 (8 columns) spine: share 90-91%, all P, RGP 0.2%. Genes: mukB "chromosome partition protein MukB", mukE, mukF, cmoM, elyC, ycbJ "YcbJ family phosphotransferase", kdsB, ycaR "protein YcaR". named 57-99.8% (mean 88%), fewest named at column 14 (mukF), named 57%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.15 bits (column 12 (mukB)).
[S8] 8. column 20 variable: share 88%, all P, RGP 0.2%. named 98%; 0.14 bits.
[S8.c20]    20: ycaQ P 88% "crosslink repair DNA glycosylase Yc…"
[S9] 9. columns 21-22 (2 columns) spine: share 90-91%, all P, RGP 0.2%. Genes: lpxK, msbA. named 99-99.6% (mean 99.5%), fewest named at column 21 (lpxK), named 99%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.06 bits (column 22 (msbA)).
[S10] 10. column 23 variable: share 82%, all P, RGP 0.4%. named 92%; 0.39 bits.
[S10.c23]    23: ycaI P 82% "ComEC family protein"
[S11] 11. columns 24-26 (3 columns) spine: share 90%, all P, RGP 0.4%. Genes: ihfB, rpsA, cmk. named 97-99.6% (mean 99%), fewest named at column 24 (ihfB), named 97%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.13 bits (column 24 (ihfB)).
[S12] 12. column 27 variable: share 89%, all P, RGP 0.4%. named 98%; 0.08 bits.
[S12.c27]    27: ycaL P 89% "metallopeptidase YcaL"
[S13] 13. columns 28-29 (2 columns) spine: share 90%, all P, RGP 1%. Genes: aroA, serC. named 97-99% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 28 (aroA), named 97%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.12 bits (column 28 (aroA)).
[S14] 14. column 30 variable: share 89%, all P, RGP 1%. named 99%; 0.16 bits.
[S14.c30]    30: ycaP P 89% "DUF421 domain-containing protein"
[S15] 15. columns 31-32 (2 columns) spine: share 90%, all P, RGP 1-3%. Genes: ycaO "30S ribosomal protein S12 methylthi…", focA. named 99%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.11 bits (column 31 (ycaO)).
[S16] 16. columns 33-79 (47 columns) fork and variable columns: share 49-90%, 44 P, 3 S, RGP 11-25%. named 62-98% (mean 88%), fewest named at column 76, named 62%; most hesitant at column 65, 0.77 bits.

[S16.c60]    60 fork: ybjD P 74% "ATP-dependent endonuclease"; also "IS1 family transposase" S 12%
[S16.c61-78]    columns 61-78 variable, share 63-73%, all P: aqpZ 70%, lysO 73%, hcp 73%, hcr 73%, poxB 72%, ltaE 72%, ybjT "SDR family oxidoreductase" 71%, ybjS "NAD-dependent epimerase/dehydratase…" 71%, amiD 70%, ybjQ "heavy metal-binding domain-containi…" 70%, ybjP "lipoprotein" 70%, artP 71%, artI 70%, artQ "arginine ABC transporter permease A…" 70%, artM 70%, artJ 69%, rlmC 65%, ybjO "YbjO family protein" 63%
